children: Armstrong World Industries posted an updated investor presentation highlighting 2025 results and reaffirming full-year 2026 guidance with targeted growth in sales, adjusted EBITDA, EPS and free cash flow.
Posted updated August 2026 Investor Presentation to investor website ahead of meetings; Exhibit 99.1 furnished with the 8-K.
Reported 2025 results: $1,621M net sales, $555M adjusted EBITDA, $346M adjusted free cash flow, $7.41 adjusted diluted EPS.
Reiterated/raised full-year 2026 guidance midpoints: Net Sales $1,770–$1,800M; Adj. EBITDA $605–$620M; Adj. Diluted EPS $8.30–$8.50; Adj. Free Cash Flow $380–$395M.
Outlined segment strengths and assumptions: Mineral Fiber ~7% growth, MF AUV and WAVE equity earnings growth; AS 15–17% growth and ~19% Adj. EBITDA margin (includes Eventscape acquisition).
Emphasized strategic priorities—acquisitions, product innovation, energy-saving and data center solutions—to drive volume, AUV growth and shareholder value.
